creator: Alexander Terp
description: Minor. At a shell a dead program left in kitty report-all-keys, pane send's Return is now a plain carriage return (2026-11-13), but the keys before it are still encoded with the kitty flags. zsh ignored the encoded End in the test; another key could type junk.
title: Encode a send's keys without stale kitty flags at a shell in front
